Big names. Big ideas. All in one place. 

Registration for the 2026 CAP IDEAS Conference is officially open! RSVP now to learn from today's leading thinkers and doers to solve the problems facing Americans now, and keep an eye out for more speakers to be announced: capideas.org

Video
The world must align climate & trade policies. Proactive international cooperation is the only way forward. CAP’s Ryan Mulholland & coauthors explain: inettt.org/news-blog/unilate…

"This terrible decision is part of the right-wing majority’s continued attack on democracy, civil rights, and the American people. The court is hiding behind the guise of racial neutrality to undermine civil rights laws designed to protect voters of color from racism that still persists, especially across the South." ampr.gs/4n0LaZk

The American Franchise Act would let corporate franchisors off the hook when they undermine workers’ rights and leave small franchisees solely liable for labor law violations. americanprogress.org/article…

Today, the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling that drastically undermines a central provision of the Voting Rights Act of 1965 that has been used for more than half a century to fight racial discrimination in voting and prevent the disenfranchisement of Black Americans and other voters of color. 

In response, @NeeraTanden, president and CEO of CAP, issued the following statement: americanprogress.org/press/s…

WATCH LIVE: Representatives from CAP, @AFLCIOTech, @civilrightsorg, @Public_Citizen, and @publicknowledge will be discussing federal AI legislation at 1 PM EDT today. nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1yxBeMwam…

Eight years after child care deserts were first documented, nearly half of America's young children still lack access to licensed care. 

New from CAP: 46% of children under 6 live in a child care desert in 2025, with remote rural families at 70%. ampr.gs/4vVdhND

Union organizing is not the only path to growing union membership. Unions need strong, favorable policies that provide multiple reasons to join unions in order to thrive. americanprogress.org/article…

The global hunger and health emergency unfolding right now is the direct consequence of Trump's war of choice in Iran.

Video
By failing to limit chemicals and toxic pollution, the Trump administration is letting corporate polluters endanger children's health—while undercutting its own MAHA agenda. ampr.gs/4bUiRZ9
